instantiate_wrapper_agent: instantiate a wrapper Agent using hydra to wrap another agent for multitask RL algorithms
select_action_multitask: select an action from the wrapped agent given a multitask observation and mode list
update_agent_from_buffer: update the wrapped agent using a replay buffer, logger, and current training step
save_and_load_agent: save the wrapped agent model to disk or load it from a checkpoint directory
train_wrapper_agent: set the wrapped agent into training mode and toggle training state
